messages:
ana (PM): Quick status check — we need a compact launch checklist for next week's decision: SLA language, monitoring alerts, support routing, docs snippets, and pricing tiers. Who wants which?

josh (Eng): Ill own SLA wording + example configs. Question: should hosted have a single public SLO or two tiers (standard/priority)?

rita (SRE): Two tiers preferred. Standard: availability 99.9 + best-effort latency. Priority: availability 99.95 + latency p95 target. Need to define rollback and fallback model behavior.

tom (Docs): I'll draft both customer-facing and internal SLA pages. Tom needs exact breach payloads and credit calc. Also want sample API responses for throttles and degraded-mode.

emma (Pricing): Pricing wants delta estimates. My rough calc: Priority ~+30% unit cost vs Standard (depends on workload). Dedicated will be contract-negotiated. Need sample invoices for 10k rps and 100k tokens/day.

miguel (Support): Support will prepare L1 playbook and paging rules. For Priority customers we do 24/7 paging; Standard gets business-hours. Need to know who signs off for cross-region incident splits.

ci-bot: deploy-checks scheduled: launch-readiness-smoke @ 2026-06-03T08:00Z. Failures will ping #deploys.

ana (ana typo correction): (ana): disregard previous typo, continuing.

josh (Eng): SLA breach payload example (use in docs):
```{
  "account_id": "acct_001",
  "window": "2026-06-01T00:00Z/2026-06-07T23:59Z",
  "p95_ms": 320,
  "slo_p95_ms": 200,
  "availability_pct": 99.88,
  "slo_availability": 99.95,
  "credit_usd": "min(0.05 * monthly_invoice, 10000)"
}```

rita (SRE): Monitoring items: synthetic p95 & p99 across three regions, cache hit-rate histogram, hot-pool utilization, and cold-start rate metric. Alerts: p95 spike > 20% over baseline for 5m -> sev2; sustained 15m -> page sev1.

tom (Docs): I'll include a short troubleshooting table: "If p95 spikes and hot-pool >80% -> action: scale hot-pool, pre-warm prefixes". Need exact runbook link.

emma (Pricing): For pilot (invite-only) we'll offer Priority at no upfront uplift for first 30 days but meter normally, with SLA credits enabled. After pilot we move to +30% list price. This helps adoption.

miguel (Support): Pilot ops: dedicated Slack channel + single POC email, dedicated oncall for the pilot window. I'll create training checklist and shadow sessions with SRE.

ana (ana again): I propose gating GA on: 1) pilot stability (no sev1 > 48h), 2) billing/credit automation tested, 3) docs and playbooks published, 4) monitoring dashboards live. Agree?

josh (Eng): Agreed. I'll add one more gate: cold-starts under 0.5% of requests at 95th percentile during synthetic load.

rita (SRE): Also require runbook-tested failover to fallback model with <2m RTO in simulations.

tom (Docs): I'll aim to publish the public SLA draft + internal runbook links by tomorrow EOD.

emma (Pricing): I'll drop example invoices and a short blurb for docs (customer-facing) by EOD.

miguel (Support): L1 playbook draft and paging matrix by EOD.

ana (ana): Great. Owners: josh -> SLA + breach payloads; rita -> monitoring/alerts + runbook; tom -> docs; emma -> pricing sheet; miguel -> support playbook. We'll reconvene Thu to validate pilot readiness. :thumbsup:

josh (Eng): on it.

rita (SRE): on it.

tom (Docs): Will ping for copy review.

emma (Pricing): will post spreadsheet.

miguel (Support): setting up pilot channel now.

ci-bot: reminder scheduled: launch-readiness-review @ 2026-06-04T16:00Z.
